name: Yuragi
source:
Yuragi is an ’ex-sentinel’, a retired adventurer who once swore to protect humanity from the monster menace. Specializing in defensive skills and always shielding her loved ones behind her ample bosom, she’s the real ’tank’ of the party.

She also is an ardent believer of Mother Eve, the deity who is said to have given birth to the world. Always striving to follow her teachings, Yuragi is maidenly and honest to a fault. Even her friends must admit she can be a little naive from time to time. 

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1268&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]Mangagamer[/url]]
